ideas.pitch: A Python-based static and dynamic analysis command-line tool that parses OpenAPI specs and intercepts HTTP traffic to automatically test for BOLA and vertical privilege escalation vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: AuthAudit CLI: Automated Broken Object Level Authorization Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the API Security and Authentication vs Authorization challenge focus areas, giving judges a practical tool they can immediately use to find real-world flaws.

ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth middleware proxy that sanitizes incoming API prompts using dual-layer heuristics and deterministic regex boundaries before forwarding requests to backend LLMs.
ideas.title: PromptShield: Layered Prompt-Injection Hardener for LLM APIs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven defense-in-depth architecture pattern that won past agent challenges, addressing modern API security risks inherent to AI integration.

ideas.pitch: A Python tool that ingests raw Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP XML scan files and automatically generates executive-ready markdown reports with severity scores and remediation code snippets.
ideas.title: VulnLens: Automated Web Vulnerability Report Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture and workflow of the Microsoft Global Intern Hackathon winner by transforming security data into actionable developer insights.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web dashboard that inspects JSON Web Tokens, tests for common signature algorithm confusion attacks (RS256 to HS256), and audits expiration claims.
ideas.title: OAuthScope: JWT Configuration & Misuse Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on authentication and authorization fundamentals, hitting the core scoring criteria for practical cybersecurity scenario testing.

ideas.pitch: A local-first retrieval-augmented generation assistant loaded with OWASP Top 10 documentation and CWE databases to help junior developers query and remediate secure coding anti-patterns.
ideas.title: SecAgent: Local RAG-Powered VAPT Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous educational utility with technical execution, appealing to judges evaluating how well participants understand vulnerability analysis.
